ucs.title: [LLM] APT37 (ScarCruft) RokRat bidirectional C2 over cloud-storage APIs
ucs.description: Hunts non-cloud-sync processes communicating with Dropbox, pCloud and Yandex Disk REST endpoints — APT37's signature RokRat / DOGCALL family abuses these consumer cloud APIs as a bidirectional C2 channel (T1102.002) to blend into permitted egress.
ucs.splunk:
| tstats summariesonly=false count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime
    from datamodel=Network_Traffic.All_Traffic
    where All_Traffic.dest_host IN ("api.dropboxapi.com","content.dropboxapi.com","api.dropbox.com","api.pcloud.com","eapi.pcloud.com","cloud-api.yandex.net","webdav.yandex.ru")
    by All_Traffic.src, All_Traffic.user, All_Traffic.app, All_Traffic.dest_host, All_Traffic.dest_port
| `drop_dm_object_name(All_Traffic)`
| where NOT app IN ("dropbox.exe","onedrive.exe","onedrive.exe","yandexdisk.exe","pcloud.exe","msedge.exe","chrome.exe","firefox.exe","iexplore.exe","teams.exe","outlook.exe","onenote.exe","backupandsync.exe")
| convert ctime(firstTime), ctime(lastTime)
| sort - lastTime
ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let RokRatHosts = dynamic([
    "api.dropboxapi.com","content.dropboxapi.com","api.dropbox.com",
    "api.pcloud.com","eapi.pcloud.com",
    "cloud-api.yandex.net","webdav.yandex.ru"
]);
let LegitSyncClients = dynamic([
    "dropbox.exe","onedrive.exe","yandexdisk.exe","pcloud.exe",
    "msedge.exe","chrome.exe","firefox.exe","iexplore.exe",
    "teams.exe","outlook.exe","onenote.exe","backupandsync.exe"
]);
DeviceNetworkEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
| where RemoteUrl has_any (RokRatHosts)
| where InitiatingProcessFileName !in~ (LegitSyncClients)
| where InitiatingProcessAccountName !endswith "$"
| where not(InitiatingProcessFolderPath has_any (@"\Program Files\Microsoft Office\", @"\Program Files (x86)\Microsoft Office\", @"\Program Files\Microsoft\Edge\"))
| summarize Hits = count(), FirstSeen = min(Timestamp), LastSeen = max(Timestamp),
            SampleCmd = any(InitiatingProcessCommandLine),
            DistinctHosts = make_set(RemoteUrl, 20),
            SHA = any(InitiatingProcessSHA256)
        by DeviceName, InitiatingProcessAccountName, InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessFolderPath
| order by LastSeen desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let RokRatHosts = dynamic([
    "api.dropboxapi.com","content.dropboxapi.com","api.dropbox.com",
    "api.pcloud.com","eapi.pcloud.com",
    "cloud-api.yandex.net","webdav.yandex.ru"
]);
let LegitUserAgents = dynamic([
    "Dropbox","OfficialDropbox","Yandex","YandexDisk","pCloud",
    "OneDrive","Microsoft Office","WebDAV","Edge","Chrome","Firefox","Mozilla"
]);
ImWebSession
| where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
| where HttpHostName has_any (RokRatHosts) or Url has_any (RokRatHosts)
| where isempty(HttpRequestHeaderUserAgent)
     or not(HttpRequestHeaderUserAgent has_any (LegitUserAgents))
| summarize Hits = count(), FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated),
            UAs = make_set(HttpRequestHeaderUserAgent, 10),
            URLs = make_set(Url, 10)
        by SrcHostname, SrcUsername, SrcIpAddr, HttpHostName
| order by LastSeen desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: APT37 (ScarCruft) RokRat Cloud Storage C2
id: 7c2f8a4e-1a2b-4c3d-9e8f-0a1b2c3d4e5f
status: experimental
description: Detects non-cloud-sync processes communicating with Dropbox / pCloud / Yandex Disk APIs used by APT37 RokRat / DOGCALL for bidirectional C2
references:
  - https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0067/
  - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1102/002/
author: SOC Detection Team
date: 2026-05-21
tags:
  - attack.command_and_control
  - attack.t1102.002
  - attack.t1071.001
  - attack.g0067
logsource:
  category: network_connection
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_dest:
    DestinationHostname:
      - 'api.dropboxapi.com'
      - 'content.dropboxapi.com'
      - 'api.dropbox.com'
      - 'api.pcloud.com'
      - 'eapi.pcloud.com'
      - 'cloud-api.yandex.net'
      - 'webdav.yandex.ru'
  filter_legit:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\dropbox.exe'
      - '\onedrive.exe'
      - '\yandexdisk.exe'
      - '\pcloud.exe'
      - '\msedge.exe'
      - '\chrome.exe'
      - '\firefox.exe'
      - '\iexplore.exe'
      - '\teams.exe'
      - '\outlook.exe'
      - '\onenote.exe'
  condition: selection_dest and not filter_legit
falsepositives:
  - Third-party backup utilities pushing to personal Dropbox / pCloud / Yandex
  - Custom developer / data-engineering tools using these APIs
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:3 @DestinationHostname:(api.dropboxapi.com OR content.dropboxapi.com OR api.dropbox.com OR api.pcloud.com OR eapi.pcloud.com OR cloud-api.yandex.net OR webdav.yandex.ru) -@Image:(*\\Dropbox.exe OR *\\dropbox.exe OR *\\OneDrive.exe OR *\\onedrive.exe OR *\\ONEDRIVE.EXE OR *\\YandexDisk.exe OR *\\yandexdisk.exe OR *\\pCloud.exe OR *\\pcloud.exe OR *\\msedge.exe OR *\\MsEdge.exe OR *\\MSEDGE.EXE OR *\\chrome.exe OR *\\Chrome.exe OR *\\firefox.exe OR *\\Firefox.exe OR *\\iexplore.exe OR *\\IEXPLORE.EXE OR *\\Teams.exe OR *\\teams.exe OR *\\OUTLOOK.EXE OR *\\outlook.exe OR *\\onenote.exe OR *\\ONENOTE.EXE)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=DnsRequest DomainName=/^(api\.dropboxapi\.com|content\.dropboxapi\.com|api\.dropbox\.com|api\.pcloud\.com|eapi\.pcloud\.com|cloud-api\.yandex\.net|webdav\.yandex\.ru)$/i
| NOT ContextImageFileName=/\\(dropbox|onedrive|yandexdisk|pcloud|msedge|chrome|firefox|iexplore|teams|outlook|onenote)\.exe$/i
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, ContextImageFileName, DomainName], function=count(as=hits))
| hits >= 1
ucs.rationale: Of all tracked Chollima clusters, only APT37 (ScarCruft / Reaper / InkySquid) operationally treats Dropbox / pCloud / Yandex Disk REST APIs as bidirectional C2 channels — RokRat embeds OAuth tokens for these providers and uses GET /files/list_folder (Dropbox) and /1/listfolder (pCloud) as the command-poll primitive. Lazarus / Kimsuky favour attacker-owned web shells and HTTP(S) to compromised CMS;

ucs.title: [LLM] APT37 Hancom Office (HWP) / CHM spawning interpreter or LOLBin
ucs.description: Hunts Hancom Word Processor / HCell / HShow / CHM viewer (hh.exe) launching a script interpreter or download LOLBin — APT37's principal initial-execution chain against South Korean targets (defectors, journalists, MoU, MoFA). The hwp.exe → powershell/mshta/cmd pivot is essentially unique to ScarCruft because no other tracked actor regularly weaponises the Hancom suite.
ucs.splunk:
| tstats summariesonly=false count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime
    from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes
    where Processes.parent_process_name IN ("hwp.exe","hwpx.exe","hcell.exe","hshow.exe","hh.exe")
      AND Processes.process_name IN ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe","mshta.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","bitsadmin.exe","certutil.exe","curl.exe")
    by Processes.dest, Processes.user, Processes.parent_process_name, Processes.process_name, Processes.process, Processes.parent_process
| `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)`
| where NOT match(user, "\$$")
| convert ctime(firstTime), ctime(lastTime)
| sort - lastTime
ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 14d;
let KoreanOfficeParents = dynamic([
    "hwp.exe","hwpx.exe","hcell.exe","hshow.exe",   // Hancom Office
    "hh.exe"                                          // CHM viewer
]);
let SuspiciousChildren = dynamic([
    "powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe","mshta.exe",
    "wscript.exe","cscript.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe",
    "bitsadmin.exe","certutil.exe","curl.exe"
]);
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
| where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (KoreanOfficeParents)
| where FileName in~ (SuspiciousChildren)
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| extend Chain = strcat(tolower(InitiatingProcessFileName), " -> ", tolower(FileName))
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, Chain,
          ParentPath = InitiatingProcessFolderPath,
          ParentCmd  = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          ChildPath  = FolderPath,
          ChildCmd   = ProcessCommandLine,
          ChildSHA256 = SHA256
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookbackDays = 14d;
let KoreanOfficeParents = dynamic([
    "hwp.exe","hwpx.exe","hcell.exe","hshow.exe","hh.exe"
]);
let SuspiciousChildren = dynamic([
    "powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe","mshta.exe",
    "wscript.exe","cscript.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe",
    "bitsadmin.exe","certutil.exe","curl.exe"
]);
ImProcessCreate
| where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
| extend ParentBase = tolower(tostring(split(ParentProcessName, "\\")[-1]))
| extend ChildBase  = tolower(tostring(split(TargetProcessName, "\\")[-1]))
| where ParentBase in~ (KoreanOfficeParents)
| where ChildBase  in~ (SuspiciousChildren)
| where ActorUsername !endswith "$"
| project TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, ActorUsername,
          ParentBase, ParentProcessName, ParentProcessCommandLine,
          ChildBase, TargetProcessName, TargetProcessCommandLine,
          SHA256
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: APT37 (ScarCruft) Hancom Office or CHM Spawning Interpreter / LOLBin
id: 4f1a6b2c-9d3e-4a8f-b1c2-3d4e5f6a7b8c
status: experimental
description: Detects Hancom Office (HWP/HWPX/HCell/HShow) or CHM viewer (hh.exe) launching a script interpreter or download LOLBin - APT37's primary initial-execution chain against South Korean targets
references:
  - https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0067/
  - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1204/002/
  - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1203/
author: SOC Detection Team
date: 2026-05-21
tags:
  - attack.execution
  - attack.t1204.002
  - attack.t1203
  - attack.t1059.001
  - attack.g0067
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_parent:
    ParentImage|endswith:
      - '\hwp.exe'
      - '\hwpx.exe'
      - '\hcell.exe'
      - '\hshow.exe'
      - '\hh.exe'
  selection_child:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\powershell.exe'
      - '\pwsh.exe'
      - '\cmd.exe'
      - '\mshta.exe'
      - '\wscript.exe'
      - '\cscript.exe'
      - '\rundll32.exe'
      - '\regsvr32.exe'
      - '\bitsadmin.exe'
      - '\certutil.exe'
      - '\curl.exe'
  filter_machine:
    User|endswith: '$'
  condition: selection_parent and selection_child and not filter_machine
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate Hancom macros that call scripting hosts (rare outside Korean enterprises)
  - Internal CHM-based documentation that invokes shell helpers
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 @ParentImage:(*\\hwp.exe OR *\\Hwp.exe OR *\\HWP.EXE OR *\\hwpx.exe OR *\\HWPX.EXE OR *\\hcell.exe OR *\\Hcell.exe OR *\\HCELL.EXE OR *\\hshow.exe OR *\\Hshow.exe OR *\\HSHOW.EXE OR *\\hh.exe OR *\\HH.exe OR *\\HH.EXE) @Image:(*\\powershell.exe OR *\\PowerShell.exe OR *\\POWERSHELL.EXE OR *\\pwsh.exe OR *\\cmd.exe OR *\\CMD.EXE OR *\\mshta.exe OR *\\MSHTA.EXE OR *\\wscript.exe OR *\\WSCRIPT.EXE OR *\\cscript.exe OR *\\CSCRIPT.EXE OR *\\rundll32.exe OR *\\RUNDLL32.EXE OR *\\regsvr32.exe OR *\\REGSVR32.EXE OR *\\bitsadmin.exe OR *\\BITSADMIN.EXE OR *\\certutil.exe OR *\\CERTUTIL.EXE OR *\\curl.exe OR *\\CURL.EXE)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ParentBaseFileName=/^(hwp|hwpx|hcell|hshow|hh)\.exe$/i
| ImageFileName=/\\(powershell|pwsh|cmd|mshta|wscript|cscript|rundll32|regsvr32|bitsadmin|certutil|curl)\.exe$/i
| NOT UserName=/\$$/
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ParentBaseFileName, ImageFileName], function={ count(as=hits) | sample := any(CommandLine) })
| hits >= 1
ucs.rationale: APT37 (ScarCruft / Reaper / Group123) is the only tracked DPRK cluster that consistently weaponises Hangul Word Processor — its target set is Korean-language (defector NGOs, MoU/MoFA, journalists covering DPRK, human-rights orgs), so Hancom Office is the dominant document reader and HWP/HWPX files are their delivery format of choice (Kaspersky 2018 RokRat, Volexity 2021 InkySquid, EST Security Red
